how_to_apply: Only online applications are accepted. The application has two parts: registration on the Government apprenticeship portal, then the application on the BHEL portal.
Go to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, click "Register" and choose "candidate".
Fill in all personal details and click submit; note the 10-digit unique registration number shown on screen, which must be entered in the BHEL online apprentice portal.
Open the e-mail with the subject "User activation" in your registered mailbox and click the activate button.
Log in to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in with the registered mail ID/registration number and password, and complete your profile under the "profile" tab using the EDIT and ADD buttons.

Complete Aadhaar verification, which is mandatory for creating the online apprenticeship contract; your name, date of birth, gender and father's name in Aadhaar must match your 10th standard (SSLC) mark sheet. If there is a discrepancy, get the Aadhaar corrected from the concerned agency.
Complete e-KYC verification by filling in bank details and IFSC code correctly.
Go to https://trichy.bhel.com and click the link "Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)".
Click "Register" from the menu, read the instructions and accept by clicking "I agree".
Fill in the registration form and click "REGISTER"; an OTP will be sent to your registered e-mail ID and mobile number.
Create a new password using the OTP and log in to the portal with it.
Fill in the application form, including your RDSDE (NAPS) registration number.
Upload the scanned documents listed below, in the size indicated in the portal.
Submit the application by 10 December 2026 and save a copy to produce at document verification.
Latest passport size colour photograph
Candidate's signature
10th Standard mark sheet
Consolidated mark sheet of prescribed educational qualification
Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC (NCL), EWS, PwD certificate); the OBC (NCL) and EWS certificate must be as per the latest government guidelines and not older than one year
Aadhaar Card
Screenshot of the candidate's profile home page on the Govt. portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in)
Bank passbook front page as uploaded in the Govt. portal, Aadhaar seeded and DBT enabled
If any single document is missing, the application shall be summarily rejected. Blurred or edited images and incorrect documents will also be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, applications not meeting the eligibility criteria and applications sent in any mode other than online will be treated as "Rejected". The candidate must verify all information before final submission and is wholly responsible for the details given in the online form. All future communication will take place only through the website, e-mail and SMS alerts, so candidates should check https://trichy.bhel.com and their registered e-mail regularly. No TA/DA will be paid for certificate verification or for joining the apprenticeship training. Canvassing in any form is liable to render the candidate ineligible.

content_sections.heading: About BHEL Thirumayam
content_sections.text: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is a Government of India Undertaking, and this circular is issued by its BHEL-PPPU unit at Thirumayam. The engagement of Trade Apprentices is made under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the training year 2026-2027, and the circular is signed by N V Raja Vikram, Senior Manager (HR). BHEL has also requested the District Employment Office to share the information with suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: BHEL Thirumayam has notified 40 Trade Apprentice vacancies across seven trades. The notice calls the number in each trade tentative: it may increase or decrease in all or any of the trades depending upon requirement, at the absolute discretion of the management. Out of the training vacancies, 19%, 1%, 27%, 10% and 4% are reserved for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) candidates respectively. The notice gives these percentages only, not trade-wise category numbers. Reservation for dependents of regular employees (Serving/Retired/Deceased) will be governed as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same minimum educational qualification applies to all seven trades: High School Pass and ITI pass as a Regular Full Time candidate from NCVT recognized institute. For all trades in Table No. 1, an NCVT certificate is required. Candidates who have completed their full-time ITI course are eligible to apply. The age limit is minimum 18 years and maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026 for General candidates. The relaxations below apply to the upper age limit. Candidates who completed their ITI through Distance Learning/Part Time/Correspondence/Sandwich courses shall not be considered for apprenticeship training in BHEL. Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship training in any other establishment under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are not eligible to apply. Candidates must be registered on the RDSDE (NAPS) portal ( https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in ); only candidates with an RDSDE (NAPS) Registration No. will be considered. Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination from recognized academic institutions located in the state of Tamilnadu will be considered for selection. If Tamilnadu candidates are not available for any branch, vacancies will be filled with other candidates as per procedure for such trades. Candidates selected as apprentices will have to fulfil the minimum physical fitness standard / parameters specified in the Apprentices Act, Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 and amendments thereof, if any. Candidates must have an active e-mail ID and mobile phone number that remain valid for at least the next one year. Candidates should check the official notification for the trade-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend is a consolidated monthly amount: Rs.11,040/- for Fitter, Machinist, Instrument Mechanic, Electrician and Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), and Rs.10,560/- for Welder and Plumber / Pump Operator-Cum-Mechanic. The duration of apprenticeship training is one year from the date of joining, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961. Upon completion of the apprenticeship period at BHEL Thirumayam, BHEL shall have no obligation to offer employment to the apprentices, and an apprentice cannot claim a right to employment on the ground of completing the apprenticeship.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted. The application has two parts: registration on the Government apprenticeship portal, then the application on the BHEL portal. Go to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in , click "Register" and choose "candidate". Fill in all personal details and click submit; note the 10-digit unique registration number shown on screen, which must be entered in the BHEL online apprentice portal. Open the e-mail with the subject "User activation" in your registered mailbox and click the activate button. Log in to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in with the registered mail ID/registration number and password, and complete your profile under the "profile" tab using the EDIT and ADD buttons. If there is a discrepancy, get the Aadhaar corrected from the concerned agency. Complete e-KYC verification by filling in bank details and IFSC code correctly. Go to https://trichy.bhel.com and click the link "Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)". Click "Register" from the menu, read the instructions and accept by clicking "I agree". Fill in the registration form and click "REGISTER"; an OTP will be sent to your registered e-mail ID and mobile number. Create a new password using the OTP and log in to the portal with it. Fill in the application form, including your RDSDE (NAPS) registration number. Upload the scanned documents listed below, in the size indicated in the portal. Submit the application by 10 December 2026 and save a copy to produce at document verification. Latest passport size colour photograph Candidate's signature 10th Standard mark sheet Consolidated mark sheet of prescribed educational qualification Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC (NCL), EWS, PwD certificate); the OBC (NCL) and EWS certificate must be as per the latest government guidelines and not older than one year Aadhaar Card Screenshot of the candidate's profile home page on the Govt. portal ( https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in ) Bank passbook front page as uploaded in the Govt. portal, Aadhaar seeded and DBT enabled If any single document is missing, the application shall be summarily rejected. Blurred or edited images and incorrect documents will also be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on fulfilling the conditions of the notification. A merit list will be drawn based on the marks secured in the qualifying examination. In case of a tie in marks, the candidate older in age will be preferred. Information about the eligible list of candidates for document verification and apprentice training will be published at https://trichy.bhel.com (Our services, then Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)) or sent through e-mail/SMS alerts. The copy of the online application must be produced at document verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 tentative Trade Apprentice vacancies in seven trades, including 12 for Welder and 10 for Fitter.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BHEL Thirumayam Trade Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 10 December 2026; it opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BHEL Thirumayam Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates need High School Pass and ITI pass as a Regular Full Time candidate from an NCVT recognized institute, with an NCVT certificate for all trades.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BHEL Thirumayam Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 18 years and maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026 for General candidates, with upper age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL) and 10 years for PwD (minimum 40% disability).

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for BHEL Thirumayam Trade Apprentices?
faq.answer: The consolidated stipend is Rs.11,040/- per month for Fitter, Machinist, Instrument Mechanic, Electrician and Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), and Rs.10,560/- per month for Welder and Plumber / Pump Operator-Cum-Mechanic.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for BHEL Thirumayam Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: Register first on the RDSDE (NAPS) portal www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, then apply online at https://trichy.bhel.com through the Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM) with your NAPS registration number and the required documents.

faq.question: Q7. How will BHEL Thirumayam select apprentices?
faq.answer: A merit list will be drawn based on marks secured in the qualifying examination, and in case of a tie the older candidate will be preferred.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with ITI from distance or part-time courses apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates who completed ITI through Distance Learning/Part Time/Correspondence/Sandwich courses shall not be considered for apprenticeship training in BHEL.

faq.question: Q9. Will BHEL give a job after the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No, BHEL has no obligation to offer employment after the one-year apprenticeship, and apprentices cannot claim employment on completing it.
